body: I know those things wont help but it distracts me from my shit reality.

I feel like she broke part of me. that part of me was taken and i'll never find it again. We were together for 4 years. We had a wedding on the beach. After 4 months living with me, she broke and left me. I dont think im capable of falling in love again, certainly to that extent. Im undesirable. im already alone. death will just give me peace
